parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ClusterDNS
parameters.description: The IP address of the DNS server. If `dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst` is set in an ECI pod, this value is used to provide DNS services for the container. You can specify multiple IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

parameters.name: ClusterDomain
parameters.description: The domain name of the cluster. After this parameter is configured, Kubelet configures all containers to search this domain in addition to the search domains of the host.

parameters.name: CustomResources
parameters.description: The custom resources supported by the virtual node. If an ECI pod declares the corresponding custom resource in its request, the pod is scheduled to the VNode. The format is `resource_name=resource_count`. Separate multiple resources with commas (,).

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Elastic IP Address (EIP).

parameters.name: EnablePublicNetwork
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable public network access. Default value: false. If you set this parameter to true, the virtual node exposes a public IP address.

parameters.name: KubeConfig
parameters.description: The KubeConfig of the Kubernetes cluster to which the virtual node connects. The value must be Base64-encoded before being passed in.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The security group ID. The virtual node and ECI instances created on the virtual node are added to this security group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag information of the virtual node. You can specify up to 20 tags.

parameters.name: Taint
parameters.description: The taint information of the virtual node. You can specify up to 20 taints.

sub_parameters.name: Effect
sub_parameters.description:
The effect of the taint. Valid values:

- NoSchedule: Pods are not scheduled to the node that has this taint.
- NoExecute: Pods are not scheduled to the node that has this taint, and existing pods on the node are evicted.
- PreferNoSchedule: Pods are preferably not scheduled to the node that has this taint.

parameters.name: TlsBootstrapEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable TLS bootstrapping. If you enable this feature, use the KubeConfig certificate for TLS bootstrapping. Valid values:

- true: enabled.
- false: disabled.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. The vSwitch used by the virtual node and ECI instances created on the virtual node. You can specify 1 to 10 vSwitches that belong to the same VPC.

parameters.name: VirtualNodeName
parameters.description: The name of the virtual node. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-).
